// Generated by `krs emit-k` from krs, story-plus-mutant-b. Do not edit; edit the Rust sources and emit again.
// The `// KRS <package>/<file>: <item>` line above a sentence names the Rust item it comes from.
// A default label spells that item's path: `<namespace>--<module>--…--<item>`.
// Mutations of this K are patches in the corpus's mutations/<topic>.toml (kink/ beside Cargo.toml by default), each edit anchored by `rule = <label>`;
// `krs kink check` resolves them and shows each edit's Rust line. Why K patches, not Rust edits: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/k-rust/blob/main/kink/decisions.md#m-mutation-input

module KRS-FRAMEWORK
  syntax KItem
  syntax KResult

  syntax KItem ::= KResult
endmodule

module NAT-SYNTAX
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK

  syntax Nat

  // KRS story-plus-mutant-b/src/lib.rs: NatSyntax::Succ { n }
  syntax Nat ::= "s" "(" Nat ")" [symbol(natSyntaxSucc), group(krsgroup-ed0b6ff63cf0cba2ebb2a364), format(%1%2%3%4)]
  // KRS story-plus-mutant-b/src/lib.rs: NatSyntax::Zero
  syntax Nat ::= "zero" [symbol(natSyntaxZero), group(krsgroup-ed0b6ff63cf0cba2ebb2a364), format(%1)]
  // KRS story-plus-mutant-b/src/lib.rs: Plus
  syntax Nat ::= "plus" "(" Nat "," Nat ")" [symbol(plus), function, total]
endmodule

module NAT
  imports KRS-FRAMEWORK
  imports NAT-SYNTAX

  syntax KItem ::= Nat

  // KRS story-plus-mutant-b/src/lib.rs: Machine
  configuration
    <k> $PGM:Nat </k>
